description:
Criteria: Owner demonstrates individual login, three courts/hour slots, inclusive rolling seven-day window, at most two active upcoming bookings, no duplicates under races, own cancellation at exactly two hours and rejection below it, privacy and agreed timezone display.
Artifact: Running member site and the acceptance evidence/operating guide.
Prerequisites: Acceptance evidence and staff operating guide.
Stage-1 limitation: This is an ordinary ticket and dependency, not an enforced owner-approval gate.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
